simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֲזִיר (H2386) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: חֲזִיר (chăzîyr) means a hog (perhaps as penned ) First listed occurrence: Deut 14 8.
